title: An exited tmux runner reads idle at a handoff
description: On an isolated tmux server, launch two workers through the real role launch wrapper with a stand-in runner named grok. The first runner exits 0, so its pane survives as the role shell; the second keeps running. The retained-worker check used at a publication gate, COMPLETE and FINALIZE must read the first idle and leave the second unconfirmed. No operator tmux server, runs or slots are used.

exited-runner-idle.intent: A runner that exited cleanly leaves its pane as the role shell and reads idle; a runner still running in its pane stays unconfirmed.
